name: Glen Rein
abstract_title:
IMAGINARY FIELDS, IMAGINARY IMPEDANCE AND 

HEALING STATES OF CONSCIOUSNESS
abstract: Imaginary numbers are an important component in mathematical quantum physics. Imaginary fields associated with the imaginary plane of a magnetic field have recently been measured showing quantum-like effects. Imaginary surface tension and imaginary impedance have been reported in published articles.
